subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. 

Innate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Learned**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **'Innate' **is an adjective, meaning existing in one from birth; inborn; natural (Hindi meaning: जन्मजात).

 
 
• **For example: **"Her **innate** musical talent was evident from a young age."
 
 
 
• The correct antonym is 'L
